answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 17 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 304 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The nectar of the design is public, the ember of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the glacier of honest work is what finally pays.
